requirements.statement: When a canvas recorded in design-map.json, or the Design System page recorded in design_system.url, is not found or not accessible from the current account, /refine-design and /design-system --sync publish a new one from the committed files, record the new URL, and carry on; they do not end STUCK.

requirements.source: TRD Objectives (OWNER-CALL 2026-11-16; must pass: no; filed as #160)
requirements.statement: The no-access case of O1 (the recorded artifact exists but this account cannot open it) republishes by the same rule, sharing one code path with not-found. Not exercised in this repository.

requirements.source: TRD Objectives (brief §2; owner decision: a republished canvas starts a fresh sync base; must pass: yes)
requirements.statement: The old URL is kept as previous_url when a canvas or system URL is replaced (map entries and artifacts.json entries), the DECISIONS line says so, and a republished canvas starts a fresh sync base.
Republishing happens only on not-found or no-access; any other read error behaves as today.
/audit-design separates a below-floor contrast or target miss on a component drawn by this design from one on a reused x-import-ed component, and a hand-drawn miss stays ranked high.

The audit reads recorded accessibility caveats from brief.md '## Accessibility caveats' and design.md section 4, never edits design.md, and shows a reused below-floor miss as a known build-side caveat only when such a ruling is recorded.
Disabled controls (disabled attribute or aria-disabled="true") are exempt from the contrast floor; text explaining why is not inside the control and is still measured; target size is not exempted.
/refine-design with no feedback skips findings marked as recorded build-side caveats.
